source_title: Secret History #6: The Psychology of Evil
summary: This September 2025 Secret History lecture is already-linked Mass Society support for social control and control infrastructure, while adding sensitive seed pressure around dissociation, myth-as-script, ritual memory, and trauma programming as speculative control technologies.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Mass society's first problem is social control, and modern media, education, psychology, and social platforms are framed as later control surfaces.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public read already links exact marks to Mass Society's social-control anchor; no new episode-to-lens repair is needed.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: China, the Indus Valley, Mesopotamia, and Egypt appear as early mass societies with different control solutions: bureaucracy, religion, war, and pharaoh.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source strengthens the existing atlas-level Mass Society frame without changing the atlas.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Twitter and Facebook are described as the public face, while the deeper control surface is the military-built cable and internet infrastructure underneath.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The read already links the platform-infrastructure answer to the existing Mass Society control-infrastructure anchor.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: No public append is needed. Keep this source as support for the recurring Mass Society primitive: large populations require control systems, and modern control can move through media, education, psychology, drugs, platforms, and infrastructure.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns the scale/control surface. Secret Society owns hidden trust, secrecy, and initiation claims; Stories owns myth/script; Sacred Machines owns ritual interfaces to invisible order.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as sensitive Secret Society pressure only: the lecture frames mind control, dissociation, secret alliances, and priestly control of a ruler as a speculative model for hidden control technology.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not turn this into a generalized secret-society factual claim. Any public use must preserve the source's speculation disclaimers and distinguish Jiang's model from verified history.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as bounded Stories pressure: Egyptian myth is read as something to act out rather than merely believe, and story plus ritual can install inherited memory or identity.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Stories owns myth-as-script and inherited-memory narrative mechanics. Sacred Machines owns ritual/interface machinery; Secret Society owns hidden operator control.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as bounded Game Theory pressure: Jiang says many-player games can be won by cheating through secret alliances, but alliance membership itself creates loyalty tests and incentives for multiple identities.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns the payoff/coalition problem only. It should not absorb the sensitive trauma-programming or Egyptian ritual reconstruction.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as Sacred Machines comparison pressure: ritual, scent, masks, psychedelics, near-death experience, and mythic reenactment become interfaces that make invisible order or installed identity feel real.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Sacred Machines should receive this only as an interface comparison, not as public confirmation of the Egyptian reconstruction.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as Human Heart pressure only: hell is framed as the moment dissociation stops and a person finally feels the pain they caused, while love is described as the force that lets the soul ascend.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not append Human Heart from this source alone; current Human Heart governance is compression-first, and the source's strongest pressure belongs to control/dissociation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as Power comparison pressure: rulers and operator classes convert inner states, mythic identity, pain, and controllable experience into power over bodies and decisions.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns conversion into lived command only if later synthesis compares this with money, office, role, or institutional power. This impact should not create a public evil/power page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Dissociation As Control Technology
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Power becomes more dangerous when it can split identification from feeling: the ruler or subject acts while experiencing the event as happening to another self, making unpredictability, stress tolerance, obedience, and cruelty easier to produce.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare leadership, trauma, secret alliances, torture, education, media, psychology, and control infrastructure, but this source is sensitive and repeatedly marks the Egyptian reconstruction as speculative.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed. Public promotion would need a concept review that separates Jiang's reusable psychological model from claims about Egypt, CIA programs, torture, MK Ultra, or psychology as factual history.

new_lens_seeds.title: Myth As Installed Memory
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A story becomes control technology when ritual, ordeal, repetition, and altered experience make it feel personally remembered rather than merely believed.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This could compare Monkey Island, Egyptian reenactment, sacred machines, education, national memory, and poetry, but existing Stories and Sacred Machines pages already cover adjacent mechanisms.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as seed or future subsection material, not a standalone page from one speculative Secret History lecture.

new_lens_seeds.title: Trauma Programming As Obedience Engine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Trauma, dependency, trigger cues, and trusted handlers can be framed as a system for producing obedience or weaponized identity, especially when the subject's ordinary self is broken or bypassed.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: A related seed already appears in the Capital of Evil impact record; this lecture supplies an earlier Egyptian/War-on-Terror comparison layer but remains sensitive and source-bound.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold with explicit source-status caveats. Do not promote this into public prose without separate grounding review.

chronology_notes.concept: Mass Society / early civilization social control
chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-09-11, this source places China, the Indus Valley, Mesopotamia, and Egypt into one social-control comparison: bureaucracy, religion, war, and pharaoh.
The lecture explicitly builds on a prior Secret History class about religious worldview and Monkey Island, then promises later expansion into mass media, mass education, and mass psychology.

Any public use of the Egyptian priestly programming model must preserve the source's disclaimers: Jiang tells students to doubt him, calls the class speculation/theory, and says he has no evidence that the Egyptian reconstruction is true.

The source's modern turn links Abu Ghraib, enhanced interrogation, ISIS recruitment, MK Ultra, social media, psychology, and internet infrastructure into one dated comparison; keep these as attributed lecture claims rather than settled corpus doctrine.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: the read already links the strongest Mass Society marks to existing anchors, and the sensitive Secret Society / trauma-programming material requires review before public handling.

If this cluster recurs, write a concept-scoped review comparing `dissociation-as-control-technology`, `myth-as-installed-memory`, and the existing `trauma-programming-as-obedience-engine` seed against Secret Society, Mass Society, Stories, Sacred Machines, and Human Heart before any public prose.

Do not create standalone You Are Now The Pharaoh, Psychology Of Evil, Mind Control, Pharaoh, Dissociation, Multiple Personality, Myth As Installed Memory, Egyptian Programming, MK Ultra, Abu Ghraib, ISIS, Deep State, Social Media Control, or Trauma Programming pages from this source alone.
